description: Members returned for Irish seats at each United Kingdom general election 1802-1918, from Wikipedia's "List of MPs elected" articles: an independent second reading of who won each seat, against which the Walker harvests can be checked.

provenance.licence: Wikipedia text is CC BY-SA 4.0; only names, parties and seat names are kept, each record citing its article.
